rules.statement: There is no preference among heirs, partners or co-owners, and adjacent landowners who have a right of mortgage in the Tesawalamai.
rules.supporting_quote: "There is no preference among these classes; they are all equally entitled. Nor is there anything in the Tesawalamai to support the notion that a person coming under any two of the classes has a right of pre-emption preferential to a person who comes under one class only."
